notes:
TV layouts: more room for channels and Guide rows, compact headers and Settings with a fixed Save/Cancel footer.
Optional channel-logo grid in Channels, Favorites and fullscreen browsing, with shared search and remote navigation.
Numeric tuning is now a setting, enabled by default on TV. Optional fullscreen clock follows device time format.
Set reminders from future Guide/search details, at start or five minutes before; manage them in Settings. Saving asks for notification permission. Android may delay alerts; precise timing is optional.
Playback engines and EPG providers are unchanged.
